answers.how: A quadratic fit to shark positions gives approximately 38.1 px/s² acceleration and 77 px/s initial speed. The acceleration prior gives 38.1 px per meter.
The boat moves approximately 190.5 px/s. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 38.1 px/m gives its speed.
The boat spans approximately 384 pixels horizontally; 384 ÷ 38.1 gives its length.
The shark spans approximately 124 pixels nose to tail; 124 ÷ 38.1 gives its length.
The shark spans approximately 47 pixels vertically, including fins; 47 ÷ 38.1 gives its height.
At 0.5 s, the visible object centers are approximately 266 pixels apart. Dividing by 38.1 px/m gives the center-to-center distance.
